title: On the Fairness, Diversity and Reliability of Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applies local and global perturbations in the text-encoder embedding space to identify highly sensitive tokens, followed by a leave-one-out token removal approach under low-guidance settings to measure the unfair semantic influence of specific trigger tokens on generated images.

Generates multiple images using a single concept/token as the prompt and calculates pairwise cosine similarities to quantify generative diversity, identifying uncharacteristically homogeneous outputs caused by skewed training data or bias injections.
